skill.name: custom-hook
skill.description: Creates custom React hooks for SideDish. Use when the user asks to create a new hook, extract shared logic into a hook, or refactor component logic into reusable hooks. Includes TypeScript interfaces, memoization patterns, and index.ts export.

generated_query: I have a component that handles a text input with validation (e.g., not empty) and error display. I want to extract this logic into a reusable hook for consistency across forms. The hook should manage the input value, provide a setter with a change handler, a reset function, and validation. Please create the hook file in the appropriate location, define TypeScript interfaces for options and return type, use useCallback for memoization, handle errors with toast or a callback, and update the index.ts exports. The initial value should be configurable, and the hook should be fully typed with TypeScript.
